sentences_named.why_it_says_more_than_the_data_supports: The only control offered for it is the cap sweep 50/100/200/400/800, whose verdict_is_stable_in_the_cap = true. I re-derived that block: it is EXACTLY a post-hoc truncation of the trajectories of the SAME runs, computed by residual_at_cap() taking min over recorded trajectory points with k <= K. Every rung's continuation start was warm-started from the PREVIOUS rung's FULL-800-ITERATION minimiser. So the 'cap 50' column is not what a cap-50 ladder would have produced: at n_dof=1800 it reads 3.2798, which is a truncation of a run seeded from J0's 800-iteration answer 3.6467, whereas J0's own cap-50 value is 14.0239. Worse, the scale-invariant gradient grows MONOTONICALLY with n_dof on BOTH branches: B 23.05 -> 24.06 -> 60.11 -> 153.22; A 1.16 -> 1.75 -> 3.11 -> 16.12. Every one of the 133 starts exited with status = 1 ('maximum iterations reached'); not one converged by gradient or by ftol anywhere in the artefact. The numbers ARE banked, honestly, per start. What is missing is any sentence anywhere -- unit, close doc or STATE.md -- that says the ladder is getting FURTHER from stationarity as it refines.
sentences_named.why_it_matters: It cuts against 8.2 harder than the seed spread does. A sequence of points whose gradients grow with n_dof is the signature of a budget that has stopped tracking the problem, which is precisely the alternative 8.2 rules out.

where_the_audit_is_UNDERSTATED.understatement: the audit CONCEDES ground it did not have to concede: 'The cap sweep (50->800) supports that against the iteration budget.' It does not support it. I re-derived the entire by_cap block from the recorded trajectories: it is exactly residual_at_cap() taking the min over trajectory points with k <= K -- a post-hoc TRUNCATION of the same 800-iteration runs. And each rung's continuation start was warm started from the previous rung's FULL-BUDGET minimiser, so the truncated columns still carry the full budget from below. Concretely: J1 at 'cap 50' reads 3.2798, which is a truncation of a run seeded from J0's 800-iteration answer 3.6467; J0's own cap-50 value is 14.0239. verdict_is_stable_in_the_cap = true is therefore not a control on the budget at all, and no evidence check touches it.
where_the_audit_is_UNDERSTATED.consequence: the Conductor was RIGHT to refuse 8.2's sentence, and had a stronger reason available than the one it used.

where_the_audit_is_UNDERSTATED.understatement: the audit never mentions that the banked minimiser is not a stationary point in any sense. At the reported rho the scale-invariant gradient is 153.2 against a pre-registered gtol of 1e-12, and it grows MONOTONICALLY with n_dof on both branches (B: 23.05, 24.06, 60.11, 153.22; A: 1.16, 1.75, 3.11, 16.12). A ladder whose iterates get further from stationarity as they refine is a stronger statement of the audit's own thesis -- 'biased toward measuring no change' -- than the seed spread is, and it is sitting in the same artefact, per start, unremarked.
where_the_audit_is_UNDERSTATED.consequence: the audit's conclusion is under-evidenced, not over-evidenced.

where_the_audit_is_WRONG_in_the_conserva.text: 3i q2: an interval/NK enclosure needs a residual small enough for a contraction to close, and this one is '1.6 against a unit-normalised field'
where_the_audit_is_WRONG_in_the_conserva.finding: 1.6 is branch B's number, and branch B is NOT the unit-normalised branch. Branch B pins the far-field angular amplitude to 1 and its Gaussian-weighted interior L2 is 0.0021915332982833375 -- 0.22% of branch A's. The unit-normalised branch is A, whose weighted_L2_total is 1.0000000000 and whose residual is 7.58. The unit discloses this asymmetry at its 10 reading (c-3); the audit did not carry it.
where_the_audit_is_WRONG_in_the_conserva.which_way_it_cuts: AGAINST the audit's own case, i.e. the error is conservative. Measured against a genuinely unit-normalised field the residual is 7.58, not 1.6, so L7 is blocked harder than the audit says, not less. The re-rank to L6-b stands undisturbed and is if anything better justified.
where_the_audit_is_WRONG_in_the_conserva.verdict: WRONG IN FACT, CORRECT IN DIRECTION.

THE_RULING.on_the_one_start_claim: UPHELD AND CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY. It is the audit's genuine find, and the unit did not report it.
THE_RULING.on_the_supporting_numbers: OVERSTATED IN THREE PLACES (the 10-24x band, 'monotonically worse', and 'all 133 at 800'), none of them fatal, all of them in the same direction: the rhetoric runs slightly ahead of the arithmetic.
THE_RULING.on_the_consequence_drawn: SOUND. 'decreases_under_refinement = NO cannot yet be read as a statement about the ansatz' is CORRECT, and on my evidence it is BETTER SUPPORTED than the Conductor's own argument for it. Three independent facts force it: (i) the minimum at every refined rung is one warm-started point, so the ladder measures the continuation path and not the trial space; (ii) the cap sweep offered as the control against the budget hypothesis is a truncation of full-budget runs and controls nothing; (iii) every iterate is ~14 orders from its own convergence criterion and getting worse with n_dof. Any one of these blocks the inference to the ansatz. Together they make it unavailable.
THE_RULING.on_the_re_rank_to_L6_b: CORRECT and, in my judgement, the right purchase. It is exactly the experiment that separates (ii) and (iii) from the ansatz hypothesis: fixed n_dof = 6720, cap raised to 20000, from L6's own banked minimiser plus independent seeds. I would add one thing to its gate that the Conductor's version does not require: it should report the terminal max_abs_grad and scale_invariant_grad, not only the terminal rho, because a rho that does not move while the gradient DOES fall means something different from a rho that does not move while the gradient stays at 153.
THE_RULING.on_the_price: '~10^1 core-h from L6's own timing (1,240 s per start at 800 iterations), two orders below the ladder' -- I re-derived it: 1238.7 s / 800 = 1.548 s per iteration, x 20000 x 3 starts = 25.8 core-h. That is inside '~10^1' but at its top, and it is ~1.6 orders below a 10^3 core-h ladder, not two. The purchase is still cheap and the conclusion is unaffected.
THE_RULING.one_line: The Conductor's audit is CORRECT IN ITS FINDING, OVERSTATED IN THREE OF ITS NUMBERS, UNDERSTATED IN TWO PLACES THAT WOULD HAVE HELPED IT, AND WRONG ONCE IN THE CONSERVATIVE DIRECTION. The consequence it drew stands. The integrator did not confirm its own unit -- it contradicted it, which is the behaviour the rule exists to produce -- but it did so with prose that runs ahead of its arithmetic, which is the same defect it charged the unit with.
